texts.raw:
About Cornerstone Church of God, Rugby

Cornerstone Church of God, Rugby, was established on 16 March 2025 as the first branch of our parent church, Cornerstone Church of God, Coventry, which was established in 2001.

The Meaning of Cornerstone

In the Bible, a cornerstone is a foundation stone that provides strength, stability and alignment to a building. In the same way, Jesus Christ is our Chief Cornerstone, the foundation of our faith, our church and our ministry. Everything we believe, teach and do is rooted in Him and guided by His Word.

We give thanks to God for His faithfulness and for the privilege of serving the people of Rugby through the love and Gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.

texts.content: Our vision is to build a Christ-centred church where people can worship God, grow in His Word, experience the power of prayer and share the Good News of salvation through Jesus Christ. Through worship, prayer, fellowship and outreach, we seek to see lives transformed, families strengthened and believers united in faith and love. Our vision is rooted in the words of our Lord Jesus Christ: “I will build My church” (Matthew 16:18). We trust in His promise and stand firm in the truth that God’s work is accomplished “Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit” (Zechariah 4:6)

texts.content: Our desire is to share the Gospel of Jesus Christ, teach the truth of God’s Word and help people grow in their relationship with the Lord. As the first branch of Cornerstone Church of God, Coventry, we seek to serve the community of Rugby faithfully, fulfil God’s purpose for our church and bring glory to His name. Jesus Christ is our foundation, the Word of God is our guide, and the Great Commission is our calling. All glory belongs to God for what He has done, what He is doing and what He will continue to do through His church.

texts.content: We walk and pray throughout the streets and areas of Rugby, bringing the town, its residents, families and communities before the Lord. We pray for God’s protection, peace and blessing over the city and for His will to be fulfilled in Rugby. Every Third Saturday – Fasting Prayer and Street Evangelism Every third Saturday of the month | 11:00 am – 1:00 pm Set apart this time to seek the Lord through worship, His Word, prayer and fasting. We also seek opportunities to share the love and good news of Jesus Christ with the people of Rugby, trusting God to work in hearts and lives. We warmly invite you to join us. Whether you are seeking God, longing for prayer or looking for a church family, you are welcome at Cornerstone Church of God, Rugby. May we continue to grow together in faith, love and service to our Lord Jesus Christ.
